title: Search: at most 6 inputs, monotone outputs where an AND/OR/NOT list of fan-in two, at most one NOT gate reading a threshold, beats NOT-free fan-in-two lists
formal_statement: ∃ (n m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool), n ≤ 6 ∧ (∀ (j : Fin m) (x y : Fin n → Bool), (∀ i : Fin n, x i ≤ y i) → f j x ≤ f j y) ∧ ∃ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → (gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → i = j) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin m) (x : Fin n → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out j⟩ (List.ofFn x) = f j x) ∧ (∀ t : Fin gates.length, (gates.get t).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → ∃ a k : ℕ, (gates.get t).inputs.head? = some a ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → Bool, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn x)).getD a false = decide (k ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => x i = true)).card)) ∧ ∀ (gates' : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out' : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates', (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∀ (j : Fin m) (x : Fin n → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates', out' j⟩ (List.ofFn x) = f j x) → gates.length < gates'.length
plain_statement: There are n at most 6, monotone Boolean functions f_1..f_m of n inputs, and a list of AND, OR and NOT gates, each reading at most two wires, with at most one NOT gate, whose NOT gate reads a wire equal to [at least k inputs true] for some k, having a wire equal to each f_j on every input, such that every list of AND and OR gates only, each reading at most two wires, with such wires has more gates.
